bullets.text: Malware via Fake Interviews - **Microsoft Defender** warns of a campaign targeting developers through deceptive recruitment processes.
Windows 11 Updates Released - New builds 26100.8106 and 26200.8106 introduce features and performance improvements.
Leadership Changes at Microsoft - **Rajesh Jha** announces retirement, with new executives stepping into key roles.
SEO Poisoning for Credential Theft - **Microsoft Defender** identifies a campaign distributing fake VPN clients through search manipulation.
Email Security Benchmark Insights - Latest data shows **Microsoft Defender** effectively mitigates modern email threats.
Prompt Abuse in AI Tools - **Microsoft** outlines strategies to detect and respond to prompt abuse in AI applications.
Next-Gen Xbox Unveiled - **Xbox** reveals Project Helix, designed for seamless console and PC gaming experiences.
Windows Game Developer Tools - New updates for **Windows 11** aim to enhance the experience for PC game developers.
Modernization Solutions on Azure - **Microsoft** announces new agentic solutions to streamline IT and developer workflows.
Fireworks AI on Microsoft Foundry - New integration enhances open model inference capabilities within **Azure**.
